caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a wooden barn or workshop, with exposed wooden beams and rafters throughout. In the left half of the image, there is a black steam engine with various brass and steel components, resting on wooden planks. In the background on the right, there is a large red threshing machine with yellow decorative trim and multiple interconnected metal mechanisms, pipes, and belts. Scattered across the wooden floor are various tools and implements, including plows (with blue handles), horse harnesses, metal chains, rakes, saws, and rope coiled near wooden barrels. A lantern rests atop a green and black barrel, and another lantern hangs on a wooden support to the left. In the foreground, there are sacks, boxes, a wooden crate, a hand-cranked grinding stone mounted on a wooden frame, a green wheelbarrow, and a bucket hanging from machinery on the right. Wooden ladders and a workbench are visible in the back right corner, and various additional parts, buckets, and machinery fragments are distributed throughout the staging area. The color palette is dominated by browns from the wood, metallic grays and blacks, green, red, and some polished brass and silver tones on the machinery.
title: Barn Gangway
